Devlop Travel

Transform your Travel Agency with Global and Intelligent Management.

Ready to automate processes and boost productivity?

Contacte us

What is Devlop Travel?

Devlop Travel is an integrated management solution developed to meet the specific needs of Travel Agencies.

It covers all operational areas — outgoing, incoming, front office, and back office — ensuring full digitalization from the first client interaction to integration with accounting, HR, and supplier systems.

It also offers advanced features for financial control and automatic accounting integration, promoting a more efficient, transparent, and results-driven operation.

Management Areas

Process Management
– View and manage pending processes.
– Issue luggage tags, transfer lists, accommodations, rooming lists, and vouchers.
– Generate documents (invoices, travel documents, etc.).
– Define payment methods and automate cash movements.
– Evaluate customer satisfaction.

Integration with External Systems
– Import data from GALILEO and AMADEUS.

Transform the Management of Your Travel Agency!

With Devlop Travel, gain more efficiency and improve customer satisfaction. Contact us for a demo.

Contact us now!

Financial Management

Customer Billing
– View issued documents.
– Issue receipts.
– Control unpaid invoices and analyze balances.
– Forecast payments and manage overdue accounts.
– Integrate and control payments through the Revolut platform.

Supplier Billing
– Issue posting notices and extract listings.
– Match supplier documents with those issued to clients.

Key Features

Export data in PDF, RTF, HTML, and XLS (Excel) formats.

Electronic processing of operations.

Mailing area integrated with Microsoft Word.

Flexible application configuration (branches, user groups).

Automatic alerts: document delivery, end of trip, etc.

Internet access and generation of Multibanco references (for multiple branches, single database).

Responsibility tracking with user action logs.

Entity Management

Clients and Prospects
– Define spending limits, balances, and payment terms.
– Manage users associated with each client.
– Prospect management: last and next visit dates, import and conversion to client.

Suppliers, Agents, and Tour Operators
– Pricing tables and services provided.
– Management of room types and hotels.
– Manage and issue communications with suppliers.

Who is it for?

  • Travel Agencies (outgoing/incoming)
  • Tour Operators
  • Financial departments of tourism companies
  • Agency networks with multiple branches
  • Sales and customer support teams

Main Benefits

Full integration of processes and accounting

Organization and automation of operational workflows

Centralized management of clients, suppliers, and prospects

Reduced errors and task duplication

Modular adaptability to agency structure
